source: GME - MI-XBID continuous intraday trading results (Italian bidding zones)
description: Reference prices (volume-weighted average price of all trades, 'Esiti totali') of the MI-XBID 60-minute and 15-minute products for the Italian bidding zones, EUR/MWh. 60-minute: hourly, daily = average of the traded hours. 15-minute: quarter-hourly, hourly = average of the traded quarter-hours, daily = average of the day's traded quarter-hours. Products without trades have no value.
